title: ToolBottleneckBench: Measuring Tool-Agent Performance under Controlled Pressures and Fixed Harness Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2610.21098v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The success score of a tool agent reflects both its model and the budgets of the harness that runs it. We present ToolBottleneckBench, a benchmark that measures tool-agent performance under controlled pressures and fixed harness budgets. Synthetic enterprise tasks stay fixed while one pressure varies: the registered tool catalog, the visible tool menu, the certified workflow, or the encoding of returned records. An exact grader records the first unmet obligation of each failed episode and the harness limit, if any, that ended it. Across 21 model and harness configurations, the visible menu is the only one of the three pressures that act on the model with a large penalty, and this penalty tracks truncation at the completion cap. Raising the cap sixteenfold removes most of the penalty in the truncation-heavy configurations. translated_title: ToolBottleneckBench：在受控压力与固定运行框架预算下测量工具智能体性能
translated_abstract: 工具智能体的成功得分同时反映了其模型能力和运行它的框架（harness）的预算。我们提出ToolBottleneckBench，这是一个在受控压力与固定框架预算下测量工具智能体性能的基准测试。合成的企业任务保持不变，而每次仅变化一种压力因素：已注册的工具目录、可见的工具菜单、经过认证的工作流程，或返回记录的编码方式。一个精确的评分器会记录每个失败回合中第一个未满足的义务，以及（若存在）终止该回合的框架限制。在21种模型与框架配置中，可见工具菜单是三种作用于模型的压力因素中唯一造成大幅惩罚的因素，且该惩罚与完成上限处的截断相关。将上限提高十六倍后，在截断频发的配置中大部分惩罚被消除。大多数失败终止于某个框架限制，且失败记录对指定压力的识别可靠性并不比（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出ToolBottleneckBench基准，在固定框架预算下通过单独变化工具目录、可见菜单、认证工作流或返回记录编码等压力因素来测量工具智能体性能，发现可见工具菜单是唯一对模型造成大幅惩罚的压力且其根源是完成上限处的截断，而大多数失败实际终止于框架限制而非模型能力不足。
en_tdlr: ToolBottleneckBench measures tool-agent performance under controlled pressures and fixed harness budgets, finding that the visible tool menu is the only pressure that substantially penalizes the model—driven by truncation at the completion cap—and that most failures actually end at a harness limit rather than model capability.
